div.head: II Cn 84
div.ab: Nu bidde ic georne – ⁊ on Godes naman beode – manna gehwylcne, þæt he inweardre heortan gebuge to his Drihtne ⁊ oft ⁊ gelome smeage swyðe georne, hwæt him sig to donne ⁊ hwæt to forganne.
Nu bidde ic georne — ⁊ on Godes naman beode — manna gehwylcne, þæt he inweardlice heor[tan] gebuge to his Drihtne ⁊ oft ⁊ gelome smeage swiðe georne, hwæt him sy to donne ⁊ hwæt to forganne.

Denique sedulo precor et in Dei nomine precipio omnibus hominibus, ut intimo corde conuertantur ad Deum et semper et assidue diligenter inquirant, quid eis sit agendum (faciendum), quid uero dimittendum.
Nu bidde ic georne ⁊ on Godes naman beode manna gehwylcne, þæt he inweardre heortan gebuga to his Drihtene, ⁊ oft ⁊ gelome smeage hwæt him sy to donne ⁊ hwæt to forganne.

Now I earnestly entreat all men and command them, in the name of God, to submit in their inmost hearts to their lord, and often and frequently consider what they ought to do and what they ought to forgo.

Nun bitte ich ernstlich — und gebiete in Gottes Namen — einem jeden der Menschen, dass er aus innerstem Herzen sich seinem Herrgott unterwerfe und oft und häufig recht ernsthaft nachdenke, was ihm zu thun und was zu unterlassen sei.

Now I earnestly beg — and command in God's name — each and every person that he submit himself with his inmost heart to his Lord God and often and frequently consider very earnestly what he should do and what he should refrain from.
div.note: A forgot ‘-tan’ at the beginning of the next line.
